name: Square-taper bottom bracket
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 339 g for the BB-M550 bottom-bracket assembly with its documented 122.5 mm square-taper spindle. Both listed shell options use that spindle length; the weighed shell width is not specified. The crank weight is separate.

technical_document.title: Shimano 1992 dealer product manual, PDF page 33 / printed 30: Exage 500LX exact inventory: RD-M500-SGS 329 g and separate GS limits; FD-M500-B/FD-M500 band options; FC-M500-SG 170 mm 48/38/28T 756 g, separate BB-M550 339 g and PD-M450 518 g per pair
